data.summary:
Once per turn, during [your opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), as a **T’AU EMPIRE** unit of yours up to 6" from this unit is targeted by an attack, one unit of yours with this ability can respond:

- after that enemy unit finishes attacking, the responding unit can shoot as it would in [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase)
- those attacks can target only that enemy unit, provided that unit remains an eligible target
